text:
sam: Throwing this up for quick review : new picker in the first-run flow that asks: 'Pick a starter workspace' -> choices: API sandbox, Chat demo, Embeddings lab, Empty workspace. Mock attached: https://img.redwood.in/starter-picker.png rhea: Love the explicit choices. Two product concerns: 1) choice paralysis, 2) how much friction to create if they pick the wrong template. Can we add an inline 'Try sample projects' CTA after selection? mina: UX nit: wording on the confirm button. Current says 'Create workspace' which is fine, but for templates including data import maybe use 'Create & open' vs 'Create workspace'. Also need a short description under each card (one line) to help scannability. alex: Accessibility: each card needs role="option" in a role="listbox" so keyboard users can arrow through. Add aria-selected toggles. Also ensure the default focus lands on the listbox for keyboard-first users but do NOT auto-trap focus. aria-live="polite" announcing "Pick a starter workspace" is fine. accessibility-bot: Contrast check: card labels currently 3.0:1 against card bg. Recommend darker label or stronger weight to hit 4.5:1. Focus ring: 3px visible outline required per spec. sam: Good call. Interaction question: if user selects 'Empty workspace' we should hide the 'Try sample projects' inline CTA to reduce confusion. If they pick any sample-based template, show 'Import demo data' toggle on the confirm step. rhea: Microcopy suggestions for card descriptions: API sandbox -> 'Play with endpoints and sample requests'; Chat demo -> 'Prebuilt chat UI + sample prompts'; Embeddings lab -> 'Vector search dataset and examples'; Empty -> 'Start from scratch'. Keep to ~5 words each. mina: Keyboard flow: tab order should be listbox -> confirm button -> secondary link 'Skip for now'. Hitting Enter on a card should select and move focus to confirm. ESC should close picker and emit telemetry action=escape. alex: Telemetry: `starter_picker_shown`, `starter_picker_selected` {template: api|chat|embed|empty}, `starter_picker_confirm` {create_with_demo:true|false, import_demo:true|false}, `starter_picker_dismiss`. Add variant flag `starter_picker_v2` for rollout. sam: Decision: ship as inline modal anchored under header in first-run, default focus on listbox, card descriptions per Rhea's copy, confirm text = 'Create & open' when import toggle is on else 'Create workspace', show import toggle only for sample templates, add 'Skip for now' text link, keyboard/aria behaviors as Alex/Mina suggested, contrast fix by Accessibility bot, telemetry as Alex recommended. Feature flag: `starter_picker_v2`. mina: Dev snippet for ARIA: ```
API sandbox
Play with endpoints and sample requests
Chat demo
Prebuilt chat UI + sample prompts
Skip for now ``` alex: Add aria-live region for status updates: `
` and update with "Selected: Chat demo" on selection. Also ensure images inside cards have `alt` text or `aria-hidden=true` if decorative. accessibility-bot: Flagging keyboard acceptance tests: arrow navigation, enter selects, escape dismisses, confirm focuses next screen header. Also run contrast sweep after weight change. sam: Thanks team. Rhea can you PR the microcopy into Figma and Mina/Alex can add aria snippets into the PR? I'll set the flag and gate by `starter_picker_v2`.
